## What's new in Igggy 0.1.23
- **Every note gets the same two checks.** Before a note is saved, whichever model wrote it, Igggy drops a line with a figure that nobody said in the meeting, and turns a label like "Speaker 2" into the person's name once you've told Igggy who that is. Long meetings written by Apple's model get these checks too. - **Follow-ups always land under Action Items.** When a note writer heads its follow-ups "Next Steps" or "Follow-ups", Igggy now reads them as Action Items instead of filing them as a topic. - **Apple's notes read the words you'll see.** During a meeting, Apple's model now summarizes from the same transcript that gets saved, instead of listening to the audio a second time on its own. The transcript is ready about five seconds sooner after Stop. - **A near-empty note is written again.** If Apple's model hands back an almost empty note for a meeting over 20 minutes, Igggy writes it once more from the full transcript and keeps the fuller one. You may see the note start over once and wait a minute or two longer. - **A name you type is used everywhere.** When you name a guest whose invite showed only an email address, or Igggy has their name from Contacts or Google, the brief says "First recording with Priya" instead of the address, and the note writer is told the name too. - **Briefs connect meetings by company, never by the meeting tool.** "Last time with …" can now name a company when someone from the same company was on an earlier meeting. The name of a conferencing or scheduling tool (Google Meet, Zoom, Calendly) is never taken for the meeting's subject, so an invite held over Google Meet no longer shows "Last time on Google". Calendly's lines about the call are tucked away under From the invite, and its Meet link opens the call from Join & record. - **"This is me" where it belongs.** On a person's card, the "This is me" link no longer appears on a note you're already part of. On the speaker names card, every voice that isn't already yours offers This is me, in-person recordings included, and Undo puts back exactly the lines you claimed. - **Qwen 3.6 stops quoting its instructions.** Two example sentences from Qwen 3.6's instructions could show up in a note as if someone had said them. They're replaced with made-up ones, and the echo is gone. - **Keep each recording's tracks, for testing.** A new switch, Settings → Output → Testing → "Keep each recording's tracks", saves copies of a recording's microphone and computer-sound tracks once its note is saved. The section appears only on a Mac set up for Igggy's testing.
